top_signals.title: Treasury yields move higher as investors assess U.S. inflation backdrop
top_signals.summary: Treasury yields rose as investors weigh the domestic inflation and interest rate backdrop against broader geopolitical developments.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
top_signals.summary: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. Sources close to the investigation say one of the executives in the United States even helped ShinyHunters operate a website that pressured victims into paying a ransom.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: NYSE becomes latest exchange to extend options hours as appetite for around-the-clock trading grows
top_signals.summary: The New York Stock Exchange becomes second major exchange to announce extended-hours options trading for heavily traded ETFs and single stocks, following CBOE.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
